checks.expected: the dwell's button announces its state (aria-pressed) as it toggles
Space after idle: the first frame advances the clock as much as the next ones (one frame: 33.3 ms at the driver's 30 fps, 0.167 clock min at ½×)
checks.note: state finding 4: loop() keeps lastFrame from the last active frame, so the first dt is the 120 ms cap

checks.expected: Enter on the focused Play button after idle: the first frame advances as the next ones
paused in the ease in before the 04:15 start, '.' (the next event) goes to 04:15, the event the clock was approaching
checks.note: state finding 6: jumpEvent takes the first start more than 1.5 min ahead

checks.expected: the open card at 12:37 (same phase) reads as the app paints it at 12:37
the 07:00 phase's arrows, at 0 when 08:00 is stepped to, are not drawn brighter as they are left
with the Movement layer off, a phase change draws no arrow: the outgoing phase's included
a right press on the rail does not seek (a slider takes the primary button)
checks.note: state finding 7: pointerdown seeks with any button; the context menu is not prevented on the rail, so on a desktop where the menu opens at the press the release goes to the menu

checks.expected: after a touch on the rail ends or is cancelled, a buttonless mouse over the rail does not move the clock
